verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires splash-free mixing, establishing a persistent mechanical and enclosure acceptance condition.
The client strengthens the mixing requirement to minimal or no splashing and identifies a bowl lip or splash guard as acceptable containment methods.

value_updates.high_speed_splash_behavior: Splashing must remain controlled and operation must stay clean at higher mixing speeds.

verdicts.decision_note: The client requires clean high-speed mixing and adds whisk-position and bowl-depth adjustments; the previously accepted bowl-lip option remains valid and must not be lost during replay.
